<function=python>
<parameter=code>
cur=current_frame
def bbox(n):
    rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']];cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
def fs(A,r0,c0,w=5,h=5):
    return frozenset((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if A[r0+i][c0+j]=='B')
def norm(s):
    mr=min(i for i,j in s);mc=min(j for i,j in s);return frozenset((i-mr,j-mc) for i,j in s)
def dih(s):
    out=set();s=norm(s)
    for _ in range(4):
        out.add(s);out.add(norm(frozenset((i,4-j) for i,j in s)));s=norm(frozenset((j,i) for i,j in s))
    return out
def dist(a,b): return min(len(x^y) for x in dih(a) for y in dih(b))
nodes=cur.segmentation['nodes']
Pcard={}
for b in nodes:
    if b['color']!='B':continue
    r0,r1,c0,c1=bbox(b)
    if r1>35:continue
    g=fs(cur.ascii.split('\n'),r0,c0)
    for c in nodes:
        if c['color']=='P':
            cr0,cr1,cc0,cc1=bbox(c)
            if cr0<r0 and cr1>r1 and cc0<c0 and cc1>c1: Pcard[(cr0,cc0)]=g
order=[(4,22),(4,45),(13,22),(13,45),(22,22),(22,45)]
idx={k:i for i,k in enumerate(order)}
def read_pbar():
    out={}
    for b in [b for b in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if b['color']=='B' and bbox(b)[0]>=51 and bbox(b)[1]<=57]:
        A=current_frame.ascii.split('\n');r0,r1,c0,c1=bbox(b)
        g=fs(A,r0,c0)
        d=sorted((dist(g,v),idx[k]) for k,v in Pcard.items())
        out[c0]=d[0]
    return out
def brk():
    for b in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if b['color']=='W':
            r0,r1,c0,c1=bbox(b)
            if r1<50: return c0
    return None
def stop(r): return any(r.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete'))
# move bracket from slot4(43) to slot1(22): 3 LEFT
for _ in range(3):
    r=action(['LEFT'])
    if stop(r): print("stop",r); break
print("bracket",brk(),"pbar",read_pbar())
seq=[]
for a in ['UP','UP','UP','DOWN','DOWN']:
    r=action([a])
    if stop(r): seq.append((a,'STOP',r)); break
    seq.append((a,read_pbar().get(22)))
print("slot1 after each:",seq)
print("final bracket",brk(),"pbar",read_pbar(),"level",current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
